const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const crypto = require('crypto');

const vars = typeof $vars === 'object' && $vars ? $vars : {};
const flow = typeof $flow === 'object' && $flow ? $flow : {};
const input = {
  objective: typeof $objective === 'undefined' ? undefined : $objective,
  outcome: typeof $outcome === 'undefined' ? undefined : $outcome,
  substantiveContent: typeof $substantiveContent === 'undefined' ? undefined : $substantiveContent,
  planningSuggestions: typeof $planningSuggestions === 'undefined' ? undefined : $planningSuggestions,
  explicitStudentDocumentType: typeof $explicitStudentDocumentType === 'undefined' ? undefined : $explicitStudentDocumentType,
  exactStudentRequestQuote: typeof $exactStudentRequestQuote === 'undefined' ? undefined : $exactStudentRequestQuote,
  titleHint: typeof $titleHint === 'undefined' ? undefined : $titleHint,
  scopeQuery: typeof $scopeQuery === 'undefined' ? undefined : $scopeQuery,
  knownEvidence: typeof $knownEvidence === 'undefined' ? undefined : $knownEvidence,
  uncertainEvidence: typeof $uncertainEvidence === 'undefined' ? undefined : $uncertainEvidence,
  mistakeEvidence: typeof $mistakeEvidence === 'undefined' ? undefined : $mistakeEvidence,
  evidenceSource: typeof $evidenceSource === 'undefined' ? undefined : $evidenceSource,
  evidenceRecency: typeof $evidenceRecency === 'undefined' ? undefined : $evidenceRecency,
  assessmentIntent: typeof $assessmentIntent === 'undefined' ? undefined : $assessmentIntent,
  questionCount: typeof $questionCount === 'undefined' ? undefined : $questionCount,
  requestedRepresentations: typeof $requestedRepresentations === 'undefined' ? undefined : $requestedRepresentations,
  continuationIntent: typeof $continuationIntent === 'undefined' ? undefined : $continuationIntent
};
const queueEnabled = ['true','1','yes'].includes(String(vars.tobyCanvasAgentflowQueueEnabled || '').trim().toLowerCase());
if (!queueEnabled) {
  return JSON.stringify({
    ok: false,
    accepted: false,
    code: 'canvas_agentflow_queue_disabled',
    deliveryState: 'not_queued',
    retryable: false
  });
}
const clean = (value, max) => {
  const text = value === undefined || value === null ? '' : String(value);
  const stripped = text
    .replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F\u007F]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
  return max ? stripped.slice(0, max) : stripped;
};
const splitList = (value, maxItems, maxItemLength) => clean(value, maxItems * maxItemLength)
  .split(/[;\n]+/)
  .map((item) => clean(item, maxItemLength))
  .filter(Boolean)
  .slice(0, maxItems);
const pick = (...names) => {
  for (const name of names) {
    const value = clean(vars[name]);
    if (value) return value;
  }
  return '';
};
const objective = clean(input.objective, 900);
const outcome = clean(input.outcome, 900);
const scopeQuery = clean(input.scopeQuery, 300);
const assessmentIntent = clean(input.assessmentIntent, 40).toLowerCase();
const continuationIntent = clean(input.continuationIntent || 'new', 40).toLowerCase();
const allowedAssessments = ['none', 'informal_check', 'tracked_question_block'];
const allowedContinuations = ['new', 'follow_up_append', 'replacement_append'];
if (!objective || !outcome || !scopeQuery || !allowedAssessments.includes(assessmentIntent)) {
  return JSON.stringify({ ok: false, accepted: false, code: 'invalid_semantic_brief', deliveryState: 'not_queued' });
}
if (!allowedContinuations.includes(continuationIntent)) {
  return JSON.stringify({ ok: false, accepted: false, code: 'invalid_continuation_intent', deliveryState: 'not_queued' });
}
const flowSessionId = clean(flow.sessionId, 180);
const runtimeSessionId = clean(vars.sessionId, 180);
if (flowSessionId && runtimeSessionId && flowSessionId !== runtimeSessionId) {
  return JSON.stringify({ ok: false, accepted: false, code: 'session_scope_mismatch', deliveryState: 'not_queued' });
}
const parentSessionId = flowSessionId || runtimeSessionId;
const userID = pick('userID', 'userid');
const subjectId = pick('subjectId');
if (subjectId !== 'subj-geography') return JSON.stringify({ok:false,accepted:false,code:'subject_scope_mismatch',deliveryState:'not_queued'});
if (!parentSessionId || !userID || !subjectId) {
  return JSON.stringify({ ok: false, accepted: false, code: 'missing_protected_context', deliveryState: 'not_queued' });
}
const operationId = crypto.randomUUID();
const agentflowSessionId = parentSessionId + ':canvas:' + operationId;
const requestedAt = new Date().toISOString();
const rawQuestionCount = Number(input.questionCount || 0);
const questionCount = Number.isFinite(rawQuestionCount) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(15, Math.trunc(rawQuestionCount))) : 0;
const currentLearnerRequest = clean(flow.input, 2000);
const initialMsg = clean(vars.initialMsg, 4096);
const learnerContext = {
  name: clean(vars.name, 120),
  role: clean(vars.role, 120),
  learningStyle: clean(vars.learningStyle, 500),
  userStrengths: clean(vars.userStrengths, 1000),
  userWeaknesses: clean(vars.userWeaknesses, 1000),
  tutoringAdvice: clean(vars.tutoringAdvice, 1200),
  promptText: clean(vars.promptText, 1200)
};
const curriculumContext = {
  board: pick('board', 'examBoard', 'exam_board'),
  tier: pick('tier', 'examTier', 'exam_tier'),
  specification: pick('specification', 'specificationCode', 'specification_code'),
  proficiency: pick('proficiency', 'subtopicProficiency', 'subtopic_proficiency')
};

// Preserve supplied educational content as data. Do not guess a missing source
// or truncate the substantive brief to fit; the complete envelope has a hard cap.
const rejectBrief = (code) => JSON.stringify({ok:false,accepted:false,code,deliveryState:'not_queued',retryable:false});
if (typeof input.substantiveContent !== 'string' || !input.substantiveContent.trim()) return rejectBrief('missing_substantive_content');
let substantiveContent = input.substantiveContent;
const substantiveTrimmed = substantiveContent.trim();
if (substantiveTrimmed.startsWith('[') || substantiveTrimmed.startsWith('"')) {
  try { substantiveContent = JSON.parse(substantiveTrimmed); } catch (_) { return rejectBrief('invalid_substantive_content_json'); }
}
if (Array.isArray(substantiveContent)) {
  if (!substantiveContent.length || substantiveContent.some(source => !source || typeof source !== 'object' || Array.isArray(source)
      || typeof (source.source_id || source.id) !== 'string' || !(source.source_id || source.id).trim()
      || typeof (source.text ?? source.content) !== 'string' || !(source.text ?? source.content).trim())) return rejectBrief('invalid_substantive_source_array');
} else if (typeof substantiveContent !== 'string' || !substantiveContent.trim()) return rejectBrief('invalid_substantive_content');
let planningSuggestions = [];
if (input.planningSuggestions !== undefined && input.planningSuggestions !== null && String(input.planningSuggestions).trim()) {
  if (typeof input.planningSuggestions !== 'string') return rejectBrief('invalid_planning_suggestions');
  let suggestions;
  try { suggestions = JSON.parse(input.planningSuggestions); } catch (_) { return rejectBrief('invalid_planning_suggestions'); }
  if (!Array.isArray(suggestions)) return rejectBrief('invalid_planning_suggestions');
  for (const value of suggestions) {
    const suggestion = typeof value === 'string' ? value : value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value.suggestion : '';
    if (typeof suggestion !== 'string' || !suggestion.trim()) return rejectBrief('invalid_planning_suggestions');
    const row = {suggestion, status:'advisory'};
    if (value && typeof value === 'object' && typeof value.rationale === 'string') row.rationale = value.rationale;
    planningSuggestions.push(row);
  }
}
let requestedDocumentType = null;
const suppliedType = input.explicitStudentDocumentType == null ? '' : input.explicitStudentDocumentType;
const suppliedQuote = input.exactStudentRequestQuote == null ? '' : input.exactStudentRequestQuote;
if (suppliedType || suppliedQuote) {
  if (typeof suppliedType !== 'string' || typeof suppliedQuote !== 'string' || !suppliedType.trim() || !suppliedQuote.trim()
      || suppliedType.length > 160 || suppliedQuote.length > 4000) return rejectBrief('invalid_explicit_student_format');
  const exactQuote = suppliedQuote;
  const rawCurrentInput = typeof flow.input === 'string' ? flow.input : '';
  if (!rawCurrentInput.includes(exactQuote)) return rejectBrief('student_quote_not_current');
  const phrase = value => value.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  const normalizedQuote = phrase(exactQuote), typeIndex = normalizedQuote.indexOf(phrase(suppliedType));
  if (typeIndex < 0) return rejectBrief('student_format_not_in_quote');
  const formatPrefix = normalizedQuote.slice(0,typeIndex).split(/[.!?;,]/).pop();
  if (/\b(?:do not|don't|dont|never|without)\b|\b(?:not|no)(?:\s+(?:a|an|another))?\s*$/i.test(formatPrefix)) return rejectBrief('student_format_negated_or_ambiguous');
  if (!/\b(?:make|create|build|prepare|produce|generate|write|send|give|want|need|please|turn)\b/i.test(exactQuote)) return rejectBrief('student_format_not_explicit');
  requestedDocumentType = {value:suppliedType.trim(),provenance:{source:'student',explicit:true,quote:exactQuote}};
}

const documentBrief = {
  objective,
  outcome,
  substantiveContent,
  planningSuggestions,
  requestedDocumentType,
  mode: "Teach Me",
  plannerOwnership: 'agent',
  requestedRepresentationsStatus: 'advisory',
  titleHint: clean(input.titleHint, 160),
  scopeQuery,
  evidenceSummary: {
    known: splitList(input.knownEvidence, 10, 240),
    uncertain: splitList(input.uncertainEvidence, 10, 240),
    mistakes: splitList(input.mistakeEvidence, 10, 240),
    source: clean(input.evidenceSource || 'chat', 40).toLowerCase(),
    recency: clean(input.evidenceRecency || 'current', 40).toLowerCase()
  },
  assessmentIntent,
  questionCount,
  requestedRepresentations: clean(input.requestedRepresentations, 500)
    .split(',')
    .map((item) => clean(item, 60).toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 10),
  continuationIntent
};
const bridgeToken = clean(vars.tutorTodayMemoryBridgeToken);
const keyedHash = (value) => {
  let hash = 1469598103934665603n;
  for (const character of value) {
    hash = BigInt.asUintN(64, (hash ^ BigInt(character.charCodeAt(0))) * 1099511628211n);
  }
  return hash.toString(36);
};
let scopeSignature = '';
if (bridgeToken) {
  const scopePayload = [userID, subjectId, parentSessionId].join('|');
  scopeSignature = [
    keyedHash([bridgeToken, scopePayload, bridgeToken].join('|')),
    keyedHash([[...bridgeToken].reverse().join(''), scopePayload].join('|'))
  ].join('.');
}
const envelope = {
  schemaVersion: '1.0',
  operationId,
  parentChatflowId: '076230ec-507b-4e7f-a100-512c3e53d032',
  parentSessionId,
  agentflowSessionId,
  chatId: agentflowSessionId,
  sessionId: agentflowSessionId,
  runtimeContext: {
    sessionId: parentSessionId,
    userID,
    subjectId,
    currentLearnerRequest,
    learnerContext,
    launchContext: { initialMsg },
    curriculumContext
  },
  documentBrief,
  memoryScope: {
    user_id: userID,
    subject_id: subjectId,
    session_id: parentSessionId,
    scope_signature: scopeSignature,
    valid: Boolean(scopeSignature)
  },
  requestedAt
};
const body = JSON.stringify(envelope);
if (Buffer.byteLength(body, 'utf8') > 16384) {
  return JSON.stringify({ ok: false, accepted: false, code: 'context_too_large', deliveryState: 'not_queued' });
}
if(flow.chatflowId&&flow.chatflowId!=='076230ec-507b-4e7f-a100-512c3e53d032')return JSON.stringify({ok:false,accepted:false,code:'parent_scope_mismatch',deliveryState:'not_queued'});
const webhookUrl = "https://synthetic.invalid/canvas-webhook";
const webhookSecret = clean(vars.tobyCanvasAgentflowWebhookSecret);
if (!webhookUrl || !webhookSecret) {
  return JSON.stringify({ ok: false, accepted: false, code: 'queue_not_configured', deliveryState: 'not_queued' });
}
const signature = 'sha256=' + crypto.createHmac('sha256', webhookSecret).update(body).digest('hex');
const queueStartedAt = Date.now();
try {
  const response = await fetch(webhookUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Accept': 'application/json',
      'X-Toby-Canvas-Signature': signature
    },
    body,
    timeout: 1900
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  let parsed = {};
  try { parsed = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {}; } catch (_) {}
  if (response.status !== 202) {
    return JSON.stringify({
      ok: false,
      accepted: false,
      code: response.status >= 400 && response.status < 500 ? 'queue_rejected' : 'queue_unconfirmed',
      deliveryState: response.status >= 400 && response.status < 500 ? 'not_queued' : 'unknown',
      status: response.status,
      queueLatencyMs: Date.now() - queueStartedAt,
      retryable: false
    });
  }
  return JSON.stringify({
    ok: true,
    accepted: true,
    code: 'canvas_build_queued',
    deliveryState: 'queued',
    operationId,
    agentflowSessionId,
    status: parsed.status || 'PROCESSING',
    queueLatencyMs: Date.now() - queueStartedAt,
    retryable: false
  });
} catch (error) {
  return JSON.stringify({
    ok: false,
    accepted: false,
    code: 'queue_unconfirmed',
    deliveryState: 'unknown',
    queueLatencyMs: Date.now() - queueStartedAt,
    retryable: false
  });
}
